summary: Retest of iter_32 fixes on preview URL. Seeded TEST_CEILING_SEED (category='Ceiling Light') + TEST_CEILING_SEED_CAPS (category='CEILING LIGHT'). BOTH fixes verified: (1) HIGH — Floor Chandelier + Table Chandelier now appear in /catalog top strip (catalog-strip-floor-chandeliers, catalog-strip-table-chandeliers) AND sidebar (cat-floor-chandelier, cat-table-chandelier) even with zero products. (2) MINOR — top-strip Ceiling Light link text is now 'Ceiling Light' (Title Case) despite CAPS product in DB. Ceiling Light dynamic surfacing still works (catalog-strip-ceiling-lights + cat-ceiling-light present, filter click narrows to 1 piece). Homepage 'Shop by Category' + Footer 'COLLECTIONS' remain curated with NO Ceiling Light leak. Counter shows 'Showing 1–24 of 118 pieces' (116 baseline + 2 seeds) meeting ≥117 requirement. All seed rows deleted. Two follow-up observations (see minor issues).

ui_bugs.issue: Sidebar filter button for a fallback (non-registry) category renders the raw db_name, not the titleCased label. With CAPS-seeded product, sidebar button text shows 'CEILING LIGHT' while top strip correctly shows 'Ceiling Light'. Root cause: CatalogueBrowser.jsx line 41 maps navCats to c.db_name and line 257 renders c directly. It should render c.label (or a lookup by db_name → label) so titleCased fallback labels reach the sidebar too.

issues: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop. Check the render method of CatalogueBrowser.' Not blocking but should be addressed — likely the categories list contains duplicate/undefined key when both a fallback + registry variant appear, or when a c.db_name equals another after normalisation. Worth passing an id-safe key like c.slug or `cat-${c.replace(...)}`.

primary_bug_verification.status: PASS on all acceptance criteria from the review request

critical_code_review_comments: CatalogueBrowser.jsx currently displays c.db_name as the sidebar button label. Now that mergeDynamicCategories emits a titleCased `label`, sidebar should render `c.label` (falling back to db_name). This will fix the leftover 'CEILING LIGHT' odd casing surfaced by the retest.
React key warning surfaced in CatalogueBrowser render — investigate categories.map key uniqueness (line 252: key={c}). Should use c.slug or a normalised key.
Optional: backend /api/products/categories could case-normalise + dedupe server-side so client merge doesn't need to guess.
action_items: MINOR (leftover): CatalogueBrowser.jsx sidebar renders raw db_name — switch to `c.label` so fallback title-cased labels reach the sidebar. Currently 'CEILING LIGHT' still shows in sidebar even though top strip now correctly shows 'Ceiling Light'.
MINOR: Fix React unique-key warning in CatalogueBrowser (key={c} → key={c.slug || c.db_name}).

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter_32 HIGH (missing Floor/Table Chandelier) is fully resolved. iter_32 MINOR (Title Case fallback label) is resolved for /catalog top strip but NOT for the sidebar because CatalogueBrowser.jsx renders c.db_name instead of c.label. Small one-line fix in components/CatalogueBrowser.jsx (line 257 — swap to c.label with fallback). Also a benign but visible React key warning in the same file (line 252).
rca_of_the_issue: mergeDynamicCategories now correctly title-cases the `label` field on fallback entries, so the top strip (which renders `label`) displays 'Ceiling Light'. However CatalogueBrowser.jsx maps navCats → c.db_name and uses that string as both the render text and the setCategory filter value. Since the filter needs to match the exact product.category value, db_name must be kept for the click handler — but the visible text should read from c.label. Split the two: pass the full object, use c.label for text and c.db_name for state.
